portals.name: National Cybercrime Reporting Portal
portals.description: Official Government of India portal to report cybercrimes online. File and track complaints.
portals.instructions: Select 'Report Cyber Crime' → Choose crime type → Fill details → Upload evidence → Submit

portals.name: NCW Online Complaint
portals.description: National Commission for Women — file complaints related to crimes against women.
portals.instructions: Visit website → Register complaint → Provide incident details → Upload supporting documents

portals.name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
portals.description: Find free legal aid services and your nearest Legal Services Authority.
portals.instructions: Find your state/district Legal Services Authority → Contact for free legal aid

portals.name: RBI Banking Ombudsman
portals.description: Escalate banking and financial fraud complaints if your bank is unresponsive.
portals.instructions: File online complaint → Provide bank details → Describe the issue → Upload evidence

portals.name: SHe-Box (Sexual Harassment Electronic Box)
portals.description: Government portal for registering complaints of sexual harassment at workplace.
portals.instructions: Register → File complaint → Complaint is forwarded to concerned authority
